name: Galeb Virtual Experience
summary: The Galeb (Seagull) is a historical vessel worth discovering. This sportsboat was commissioned in 1936 by Pia and Pino Mlakar, internationally-renowned choreographers and dancers, to celebrate the birth of their daughter Veronika. The vessel recently underwent a thorough renovation by the shipbuilders of the Alto Adriatico Custom shipyard in Monfalcone (Italy). Thanks to our app, you will be able to tour the boat virtually and learn about the details of its construction and the materials used to build it. F
